subject.title: fix(agents): honor run abort signal in image and pdf tools

question: Does the current Codex app-server contract guarantee that an empty turn ID safely interrupts a still-starting turn while a non-empty ID interrupts an active turn, as this PR relies on?
rationale: The intended user behavior is clear, but the relevant protocol behavior belongs to the sibling Codex runtime and repository policy requires direct contract inspection before approving this integration.

options.title: Verify and retain the bounded interrupt path
options.body: Confirm the startup and active-turn interrupt semantics in the current Codex source, resolve the type-check failure, then merge this bounded cancellation implementation.

options.title: Narrow Codex handling
options.body: Keep image and PDF cancellation but remove or redesign the Codex-specific interruption path if the current app-server contract does not support the assumed startup form.

recommendation.title: Verify and retain the bounded interrupt path
recommendation.body: Confirm the startup and active-turn interrupt semantics in the current Codex source, resolve the type-check failure, then merge this bounded cancellation implementation.
